items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: I didn’t know about the music scene in Philly in which Rocco played before all of the Cameo Parkway records, you know Chubby Checker and Little Eva...

ctx.x: I totally agree, that you’re being faithful to this person’s personality if you happen to know them, and I agree that this music isn’t made in a vacuum.

That’s right. And how. I did a thing recently, this was another crazy project, on a trumpet player by the name of Rocco Bene. Now I happen to remember his name because in around Philadelphia, Rocco was like the guy, the lead trumpet player. So like in New York you had Bernie Glow, and in Philly you had Rocco, and of course in L.A. later on you had Al Porcino and Wayne Bergeron of course, all these great, great, great, tremendous, tremendous players. So I decided to research Rocco. And I knew about Rocco doing a…
